title: Meeting Rooms II
description:
Given an array of meeting time intervals intervals where intervals[i] = [start i , end i ] , return the minimum number of conference rooms required . 

 Example 1: 
 
```
Input:
 intervals = [[0,30],[5,10],[15,20]]

Output:
 2
```
 
 Example 2: 
 
```
Input:
 intervals = [[7,10],[2,4]]

Output:
 1
```

 Constraints: 

 1 <= intervals.length <= 10 4 
 
 0 <= start i < end i <= 10 6
approach_summary: Contiguous range with an invariant; advance boundaries without rescanning.
